audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Equinox as matchup-defining but never gives its actual cooldown, and doesn't mention Rakan's E has none, which is why the engage cycle repeats.
audit.why: Soraka's E (Equinox) is 20/19/18/17/16 by rank; her R (Wish) is 150/135/120. Rakan's E (Battle Dance) is cd 0, letting him reposition freely between engages.
audit.corrected: - Soraka Equinox cools 20s at rank 1, down to 16s at 5 — the silence zone cancels your engage mid-cast, so step out before the root snaps. - Battle Dance (E) has no cooldown — reposition freely. - Wish (R) is 150/135/120s; spend it on swing moments only.
